signals.title: retention: failed/canceled runs and child results inside a parent are never erased
signals.body:
## What
After PR #288 (#281), compaction erases the content of completed and reconciled runs. Some content is still kept forever:
- **Failed and canceled runs** are never compacted, so their input, output and step data stay indefinitely. ADR 0021 says they are kept "until the application deletes it", but there is no API for an application to delete them.
